profile.name: Riddick Burke-Garrison
profile.headline: Robotics Programmer & Technician
profile.tagline: Building Skills in Software, Electronics and Racing

about:
Hello! My name is Riddick Burke im a aspiring motorsport technology engineer based out of Bonners Ferry ID. Im (mostly) fluent in 8 programming languages and always wanting to learn more. 

Im the lead of programming and CAD at FRC Team 2130 Alpha Plus. I design all of our bots and projects in Solidworks and Autodesk Inventor and work with other subteams to manufacture parts with CAM. I also program our whole code base in Java with Wplib which entails aligning swerve drive modules, programming autonomous routines, vision systems, and much more.

experience.desc: Lead programmer on a competitive FRC robotics team. Responsible for the full software stack on the 2026 season robot, including swerve drive, autonomous path planning, and vision-based target tracking. Worked in a six-subsystem command-based architecture with WPILib Java, integrated PhotonVision across dual cameras, and built autonomous routines using PathPlannerLib. Also managed driver-station tooling through SmartDashboard.

Lead designer on a competitive FRC robotics team. Assisted in the full mechanical design of the 2026 season robot, including CAD modeling in Solidworks, assembly, and part selection. Designed and built a swerve drive system with custom gearboxes, and integrated sensors and electronics into the mechanical design.
